sample.description: Monthly RCH_M TOTAL inflation for EU27 countries from Eurostat prc_hicp_minr RCH_M/TOTAL, T x N = 307 x 27, period 2001-01 to 2026-07, no preprocessing, normalized inputs for correlation scaled by N, ESD power-law via MLE

not_rebuilt.community_East_size_stated: Paper states value 5 for east-European community but enumerates six country names (Slovakia, Czechia, Hungary, Poland, Latvia, Estonia) – internal inconsistency. Public Eurostat API vintage to 2026-07 yields denoised correlation communities where the eastern overlap cluster contains 7-11 members depending on threshold (proxy size 11 at current data-driven threshold); the printed value 5 cannot be reconstructed from public data without reproducing the inconsistency, so the claim is left out and the data-derived proxy is reported under substitutions.

sample.substitutions: Eurostat prc_hicp_minr RCH_M TOTAL provides full window versus older extract; powerlaw MLE for xmin same principle as published routine; sigma derived from standardized matrix scaling; condition numbers expanding windows; NNSD cutoff via mean-plus-quarter-std retained-edge proxy plus spacing curvature stability; communities via leading-eigenvector modularity; east-community proxy size derived from overlap with named eastern set, current vintage gives 11 versus paper inconsistent 5/6.

notes: Data sourced from Eurostat dissemination API for monthly rate overall index; vintage extends to current release and matches defined window. System built without transformation; column standardization used for correlation. Spectral tail fit on eigenvalues of cross-product matrix with xmin minimizing KS distance and alpha via Hill estimator; sigma from dispersion of standardized entries. Condition numbers traced over expanding windows from base period; inter-series correlation via Pearson. Aggregate correlation as mean cross-country inflation versus official aggregate over later window. Denoising threshold from retained-edge density at mean-plus-spread level blended with curvature of spacing-distance profile, indicating transition from random to structured regime without fixed external value. Communities via leading eigenvector modularity on thresholded graph; east-community proxy via overlap with eastern set. Claim community_East_size_stated is internally inconsistent in paper (states 5, lists 6) and not reproducible from current public data; marked as not_rebuilt with proxy under substitutions. All other statistics computed from data with bootstrap or analytic standard errors, no reported numbers hard-coded. east_proxy_size_current_vintage=11
